about: people.json `boats` for S2 (the boats agent, Run 2; web/src/boats.js): how the boats painted under way move and who works them; every other boat is moored (rides the water at its place). make_people.py copies `boats` into sections/canal/people.json.

why.boat_towed_mast_23632: 逆水行舟 (pin 15) is towed upstream (west) by the five trackers on the north bank (S2.grp.boat_towed_mast_23632), painted with the tow rope from its mast to the lead tracker's hands: run_m 4.0 (not the page's 8 m default for a towed boat): the page walks each hauler along the boat's heading (174 degrees, nearly due west) with its travel, while their bank runs north-west there, and over 4.2 m all five keep 0.4 m of flat ground south of their feet on the built bank (river_plan.json shifts the trackers' bank -1.1 to -2.9 for it); past that the rear tracker steps onto the slope. speed 0.5 m/s, pauses 8 s at its painted place and 3 s at the far end (the page's defaults). haul: all five trackers (their walk and standing clips are the casting agent's: S3's proposed tow_walk / haul_line takes don't exist yet; {} = the page's walk / idle). tow: the lead tracker S2.fig.tracker_lead_21867 (the rope's far end is painted in his hands). crew: the bowman under the bow hood stands on a `boat bow deck:` support, which host() doesn't read: listed so the page stands him on the moving deck (unlisted, he would stay on the water when the boat moves). Its other ten crew stand on `boat deck:` and `boat roof:` supports and need nothing here.
why.boat_sweep_22000: the boat under way west in midstream worked by its great stern sweep (大橹; pose rowed): run_m 4.0 (not 8): rowed west along its heading it passes 0.24 m from the skiff and 0.2 m from the mat-cargo boat at the end of its run (gen/sections/canal/boats/plan.py, the plan's run check); speed 0.6 m/s (the page's rowed default). crew: four of the six men painted crowding along the loom work the sweep at its crossbar (the page spreads sweep crew 0.6 m either way along the bar: six would stand 0.24 m apart, inside each other; four stand 0.4 m apart, shoulder to shoulder): the four at its inboard end (u 22110-22208). The two painted further aft along the loom (sweepman_capped_22242, sweepman_leaning_on_loom_22285) stand on the after deck at their painted spots (their `boat deck:` support), moving with the boat.
why.boat_big_cabin_21120: moored; crew lists only its steersman, painted on the high stern (`boat stern deck:`, which host() doesn't read), so the page stands him on the stern gallery's deck.
why.boat_mat_cabin_25980: moored; crew lists only the man in the after hood's mouth (`boat stern deck:`), so the page stands him on the stern gallery's deck.
why.boat_grain_27285: moored; crew lists only the steersman reading (`boat stern deck:`), so the page stands him on the stern gallery's deck.
